Name: White Ducks
Author: Merc931
Description:
[b]Por Que? [/b]
The green headed ducks were a pain in the arse to find in tall grass sometimes and I couldn't find any mods to this effect on this site so's I took it upon myself to help...myself.
[b]
Why should you download this mod? [/b]
I dunno, maybe you just want white ducks. Donald was a white duck, and look how successful he got. He was a wizard AND a sailor, so maybe your farm needs that kind of business acumen.

This is my first foray into modding this game so there's probably a problem with it somewhere. Find a problem? Let me know I'll try to fix it. Or I dunno, fix it yourself if you want, I'll even put your name up here for doing my job for me. Knowing me, I probably found some novel way to screw up a mod as simple as turning a bunch of ducks white.

[size=6]Read This
[/size]I pretty much only made this mod for my own personal use and uploaded it here because I found no similar mods. As such, as long as I retain access to it, you can do pretty much whatever you want with it. 

[size=4][b]This means[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][b]If you want to edit or convert this mod to work with future/current versions of any software, go ahead. I can't promise I'll be able to to do so myself. [/b]
[*][b]If you want to include this mod in any packs or anything of that nature, go ahead. [/b]
[*][b]I will not pursue any action against anyone reuploading, compiling, or editing this mod for compatibility unless it is uploaded and passed off as if it were the new uploader's work. Just give me credit for the work and all is well. [/b]
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Makes the ducks white. Kinda self-explanatory really. Maybe one day I'll make Black Ducks, but for now its White Ducks.
